videos.desc: A fruit bat hangs upside down from a cave ceiling at dusk, opens its big eyes and stretches its wings, then drops off and flies out over a still lake under a pink sunset sky, its reflection skimming the water.
A huge brown bear charges through a misty river, splashing after a fish, then rears up on its hind legs dripping water, shakes its fur in a spray and stares straight at the camera.
A fuzzy bumblebee lands on a purple clover flower in a meadow, crawls over the bloom collecting nectar, then flies across the field to a wooden hive box and squeezes in through the entrance hole.

A round orange-breasted robin perches on a blossoming branch in a garden, sings with its beak wide open, flutters its wings and tail, then flies off across the lawn and lands on another flowering branch to keep singing.
A person holds a black-and-tan dachshund up to the camera against a blue sky in a garden; the long-eared dog looks around calmly, then leans its nose right into the lens for a close-up sniff.

A black cat sits on the top platform of a tall cat tower in a bedroom while a tabby cat sits in the level below; the black cat peers over the edge and finally leaps off the tower with its front legs spread wide.
A happy black pug puppy stands upright on its back legs in a bathtub of shallow water, tongue out, bouncing and paddling its front paws like a little dance in front of shampoo bottles.
A camel strides across rippled sand dunes at sunset, then folds its legs, settles down on the sand and chews while looking straight into the camera.
A close-up of a plump green-and-yellow striped caterpillar crawling along a wet leaf in a misty forest; a green chrysalis hangs from the branch above and a blue butterfly flutters past.
A brown hen pecks around a whitewashed Greek courtyard with pink flowers, walks into a small wooden coop, settles on the straw and lays an egg, which a woman in a blue dress collects into her basket.

On an alpine meadow, a brown-and-white cow with a bell around its neck chews grass while a woman in a traditional dress milks it on a wooden stool; she pours the fresh milk from the pail into a jug, a calf comes to drink, and the cow nuzzles her cheek. Music only, no speech.
A crocodile swims across a muddy river toward the bank, crawls out onto the wet mud and opens its huge jaws wide before settling by the water.

Filmed from inside a cardboard box, a ginger cat peers down through a round hole, stares at the camera, reaches its paw inside and finally pushes its nose and tongue right up to the lens to investigate.
A large red deer stag with tall branching antlers walks through ferns in a misty forest, stops to stare straight at the camera, lets out a bellow, then turns and bounds away into the fog.

Filmed from a boat, a sleek grey dolphin swims fast alongside the railing just under the surface of the deep blue sea. It then races ahead and leaps high out of the water several times, splashing back down tail-first.

A grey donkey with long ears stands on a cobbled village street under an orange tree, staring at the camera and braying loudly with its mouth wide open. It then flops down, rolls happily on its back in the dust, gets up and trots toward the camera.

A male mallard duck swims on a calm pond under willow trees, tips tail-up to feed underwater with its orange feet in the air, then pops back up. It rears out of the water flapping its wings, settles, and quacks at the camera.

A large African elephant stands at a waterhole among white egrets, drinking with its trunk, splashing mud and spraying water over itself. It finishes facing the camera with ears spread wide and trunk raised.

A tiny orange tabby kitten with huge round eyes sits on a bed and stares straight into the camera. It tilts its head, then reaches out a paw and bats at the lens until its face fills the whole frame in a blurry extreme close-up.

At a sunny breakfast table, a black fly buzzes around a glass of tea and lands on a slice of toast spread with red jam. A hand waves a napkin to chase it away, and the fly circles back to perch on the jam jar and the tea glass.

A red fox with a white chest and bushy tail trots through a frosty autumn meadow between birch trees at sunrise. It walks toward the camera, then does its signature high pounce, diving head-first into the frosty grass to catch something, and shakes itself off.

A green frog sits on a mossy stone in a koi pond covered with lily pads under red maple leaves. It puffs out its white throat as it croaks, then leaps through the air and lands on a floating lily pad while orange koi fish swim below.
On a sunny savanna with zebras in the background, a giraffe stretches its long neck to eat leaves from the top of an acacia tree, then splays its front legs wide to drink from a small waterhole.
A brown-and-white goat with long horns climbs onto a stone wall in a village yard, chews laundry hanging from a clothesline, then walks up onto a rooftop and bleats loudly at the sky.

An orange hamster runs in a wooden wheel in its cage at night, then climbs to a bowl of seeds and stuffs its cheeks until they bulge, burrows through the wood shavings and pops its head out with cheeks still full.

On a wide green steppe a woman in a traditional brown coat adjusts the bridle of a bay horse that playfully sticks out its tongue, climbs into the saddle and rides off across the grassland toward distant yurts.
A red kangaroo bounds across the outback at sunset, stops and stands upright close to the camera, revealing a joey peeking out of its pouch before hopping away into the dusk.
In extreme close-up, a red ladybug with black spots climbs a dewy blade of grass in a sunny flower meadow, then opens its wing covers and flies off into the blue sky.
A big male lion with a dark mane walks through golden savanna grass at sunset, an acacia tree behind him. He opens his huge mouth and roars straight at the camera, then lies down in the grass.
A small green lizard suns itself on a stone wall in a hot courtyard, lifting its head at the camera. It darts past a cactus and clings to the vertical wall, its long tail hanging down the stone.

A macaque monkey climbs a huge banyan tree by a mossy temple, swings along a branch and hangs upside down by its tail. It drops onto a fruit seller's table, grabs a banana while the man waves his hat at it, then sits on a branch peeling and eating the banana.

In a warm-lit wooden barn at night, a little grey mouse peeks out of a hole in the wall and creeps toward a piece of cheese on the floorboards. It sits up, nibbles the cheese held in its tiny pink paws, then scurries back into the hole with its tail sliding in last.

An extreme close-up of a huge orange eye pulls back to reveal a grey owl staring into the camera. It perches on a branch at dusk, swiveling its head, then spreads its wings and flies off toward the sunset over the forest.

A bright red scarlet macaw perches on a wooden porch railing in front of tropical flowers and banana leaves, flaps a wing, preens its yellow-and-blue feathers, tilts its head and squawks Hello at the camera.
A gentoo penguin waddles across Antarctic snow toward the camera, flops onto its belly to slide down the ice, then dives into the sea and swims underwater past the ice edge.
A big pink pig rolls happily in a muddy patch on a sunny farmyard, gets up, roots in the dirt with its snout, trots across the yard and drinks from a metal bucket while a farmer watches by the fence.
A grey pigeon struts between cafe chairs on a cobblestone city square, pecks around with other pigeons near a fountain, then flies up and lands on a terracotta rooftop.
